content: Timotius nlernohora Paulus nora Silas
Noka Paulus nodi liarni la Derbe nhorwua noma, Listra. La hande de, riy ida mak kpesiay Yesus nwawa Timotius. Inni de pat Yahudi ida makpesiay oleka Yesus mere amni de makden Yunani.
La'a riy mak kpesiay mak kden la Listra me Ikonium, de rwetwet nek la Timotius nanni, yoma ralamni kalwieda.
Paulus ralamni nod lia Timotius pa nora talla. Hade pede Paulus nsunta Timotius. Nhi' eda de yoma riy Yahudi mak kden la gen die honona ratga de Timotius de amni de makden Yunani.

La'a leta-leta maka ha rtomra-rnah'a re, de rakot nohora lira maka makodi Uplerlawna lirni ror wutga o'ta-mata krei la Yerusalem ha ret tiarg oleka re, la'a hya' maka yana ra'ana-remnu, me oliet ir la yalira-yaliai, totpena ina-ama ama-hyali makpesiay oleka re rlernohora hya' maka ha rhi' targ oleka re.
La' hade pede makpesiay Yesus re pesiayni yeher to'a pa naruri-na'orta, ne lera-ler nekpa makpesiay re rma ra'ititar rer lia liawanni.
La'a Troas de Paulus ndarat nana yamkeka ida
Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli edonna Nwayow nohora Paulus nora Silas ra rhakra Uplerlawna lirni-tunnu la'a Asia yapatni. Pede yala'ani re rodi liarni la noha Firgia me Galatia.
La'pa rte'ela' Misia nhiakarni noma riwra rler la Bitinia yapatni, mere Yesus Nhiw Lululli Nleretia pa yana rla hande.
Hade pede rleretia Misia pa rodi liarni la Troas.
Nmel nana la Troas, dewade Paulus ndarat nana Makedonia mniotni riy ida naprir lia e gaini pa nwak lilili-mamuau lia niwra: “Ee, mtiulan pa mmuai handi pa mtiulan mai ami!”
La'pa ndarat nan hade, noma ampahi'a-mpayodi pia amodi liar mamni la Makedonia
. Yoma la'a a hmuakur mamni amparora-mpalai die, Uplerlawna Nhopna ami er mak kakot nohora Kot Kalwiedni la riy mak kden hande.
Lidia npesiaya Uplerlawna la'a Pilipi
Amto'or la Troas me amhopal pa modi liarni la Samotrake. Ne repar noma amla'awa la'a Napolis.
Ampatiawu hande pa amla'awa letlawna Pilipi, la Makedonia yapatni. Pilipi de lodna-hairi Roma yapatni. Amparin tiar lia hande lera ida-wor wuali.

La'pa la'awa Sabat lerni, noma amla'awa gerlawna aratni la'a leta puohrani wali tio'ora, yoma amna'erit nana la hande, de Yahudi kniola tieru-niawur nehla genni etla. La'a gen die wal pia amamtatnami, ne amora patke' mak kawok la gen die pa maltieri.

La'a patke'a honona re, de riy id de rpolga la Lidia, makdena Tiatira ne kniarni de na'olu-nala'a kok ungu mak welli werta. Patke' di nhi'inde nkola tieru-nawur nehla la Uplerlawna. Noma Itmatromni hihi'ini-yapyapni pa nreiniana hya' maka Paulus ha nwatutu-nwaye'a la e'a.

E nor wutga rompalli honona re pa rharania. Nhiaranni nhorwua, noma Lidia nakot mai ami: “Nar miy re, la'pa miatga toto' memna a' di de riy mak kpesiay Yesus id a'u, de mtiulan pa tla tlola a ro'mu nayanni pleini.” Nwakwak nekpa totpa amlola romni nayanni, pede ampayow pa mlernohora wakwakni.
Rho'la Paulus la roma nhio'la la Pilipi

La'a lera ida, amiwa mla mkola tieru-mawur nehla noma ampatrom nana patke' ata-wa'ara ida. Patke' de hegana nhu'ru ralma pa natu nakwiet nana hya'-hya' mak hota ktai ita, nhi'nande riy ral kupan la pede nodia unut lawan la upni-matromni re.

Hararar de nlernohor reria amor Paulus pa nhaunu-nhaunu niwra: “Hoi, hari de, Uplerlawna-Mempulwatnu mak kdella tutullu-lolo'oni hopopanni hari. Ha rmai pia rakot nohora loi-talla plele'era la ina-nara miy, totpena mlier la mormiori-lewlewna.”

La'pa lera wo'ir meman pa hararar de polpuolu-hawaunia. Noma Paulus nwarora de lawan rehi, dewade Paulus napal tieman pa nakot la: “Ee, hegana mak khu'ru ralma patke' di, agala Yesus Kristus pa aghokar doin o' la'a hararar di ralamni.” La'a mtatan de nekpa, hararar de nhiu'ru ralamni ema rho'or doinia la.
La'pa upni-matromni re rwarora de hota ir edonna rlernan kupan wa, noma rte'l la Paulus nor Silas pa ri'ita la ya'olu-yala'a geni, pa rodia la makodi plolli totpa retlia (ra'ursia) halli.
Rodia Paulus nora Silas pa rottiarga la o'ta-mata hairi Roma. Noma rakot la re: “Ri'a ri, makden Yahudi re. Rma rkokna-rrarin la let di.
Yoma rawewal wal riy pa rala nhiolli-lietni me deullu-tatarni pa rarehia deulu-tatra makden Roma ita. Mere ira deullu-tatarni de yan tatlin la, me yana tlernohora.”
Riy rahu re wal pia rho'or temna Paulus nor Silas, ne o'ta-mata hairi Roma wal pia rhopan pa riy rlihira-rnaiya rrora naniayarni me rwanalga re.
Rwanalu rrora pa nhor nioma, rwi'ita rrora la roma nhio'la. Noma rhopan pa makhi'a o'tani la roma nhio'la, natiak matmiat memna re.
Yoma mak katiaka roma nhio'la o'tani namta'ata o'ta-mat leta lira nhiopanni, pa nreiniande la nwi'it wutu Paulus nora Silas la kokio'oni. Ne rnairi ranti pa rwutga rrora lakni.
La'pa edon nhal de, mela letargara Paulus nora Silas rtepartarlia sniumbaini, me ramuki-rahepur la wniahniara pa ra'uli-rawedia Uplerlawna ne riy mak ha rho'la taru re korni mana e ratlin rer wiali.

Plinu-plinnianamde noha nruru, (upkarururu) la'pa roma nhio'la wniatatgenni mana nwo'la-nwaini. Roma nhio'la nhiarni honona ema rhar tiar momuoga, ne riy honona mak ha rranit taru re mana ema rwe'er doin momuoga.

Mak khi' roma nhio'la o'tani nhed pua namat wa. La'pa namkek nana nhiari honona rahniari, dewade nleh dioinia wehla plalahwani pa niwa nwen inonni, yoma natnieka riy mak kahnio'la honona rawlar olekwa.
Mere Paulus npolliohora, nhaun pa nakot la: “Ee, yana mpuen inonmu. A hononami erla handi.”
Roma nhio'la o'tani nwak ai (hulu) pa nawlar lia rialma, ne ndiwra-nda'al pa nwaltior tar lia Paulus nora Silas gaini ralamni.
Noma la nodia pa rlergota na'nama nakot la re: “Upa-matrom miy re, hota hya' mak aghi'a totpena alier la mormiori-lewlewna la' Uplerlawna gaini ralamni?”
Paulus nora Silas rwahla lirni: “Ama, mpuesiaya Itmatromni Yesus pa hota ommuori-mliewna, muor wutga rommu mniotni honona.”
Noma Paulus nora Silas rakot nohora Orgahi-Orha'a lirni-tunnu la'a roma nhio'la o'tani de, nor wutga romni mniotni honona.
Noma la' mel de meman nekpa makhi' o'tani la roma nhio'la de nodia ir la' pa nohma dodioinia no'oni-rarni re kdeheni-ktiahlani. Nhorwua noma rharan miemna hare honona mak kden la rom de nayanni.
Nhorwua noma nodia Paulus nora Silas pa rla' pa nhoi-ntania ya'ana-yemun la e romni. E nor wutga romni mniotni honona, ralamni re rahepur memna yoma rpesiaya oleka Uplerlawna.
Repardoin, dewade o'ta-mata hairi Roma rhopan pa makodi keki-rautu rla rakot la totpena Paulus nora Silas rlergot la roma nhio'la ralamni.
Makhi' o'ta la roma nhio'la geni nodia kot della Paulus pa nakot la: “A o'ta-mat mamni, rhopan pa rollia u'pu-matro'mu la handi. Mlia'awa ler di wa. Mliola kalwiedni.”

Mere Paulus nakot la makodi keki-rautu re: “Eh, Am di de makden lodna-hairi Roma molanni ami, mere edonna mhiudi-mpiar wali ami. Amlernana liwliwra-kakaklu la mutlialawna gaini ralamni, nhor nioma mrianti wali am lia roma nhio'la ralamni. Ne rhopan pa amla'awa, de edonna rkokan nohora ami?! Amahmena. Mhiopan pa o'ta-matmi re rmeh'a rmai handi pa ralgot ami!”

Makodi keki-rautu re rla rakot lira rella o'ta-mata hairi Roma re. La'pa ratlin nana Paulus nor Silas, de lodna-hairi Roma upni-a'nani hare, dewade o'ta-mata re ramta'at wenna yoma hya' maka ir rhi'a re edon lol Roma deullu-tatarni.
Noma rla' pa ruh' idma-rrama liar la Paulus nora Silas, na'nama ralgota rrora la roma nhio'la de ralamni, na'nama rwak la pa rlergot la let de.

Paulus nora Silas rto'or la roma nhio'la, dewade rlola Lidia romni. La'pa rrora makpesiay re rwatrom la hande, noma ral owa'ana nnio'a-niat lia totpena rhi' aruri ir pesiayni. Nhor nioma Paulus nora Silas rwaran wa.

16.10 16:10 Lukas maka khorta puka di, na'nama nor rewre'wa Paulus talla pa nakot nohora ir yala'ani.
16.38 16:38 Mak kden la Roma deullu-tatarni de, de he' maka khal de rodia la makhi' o'ta-mata pleini pa rlernana halli nanpena rliwra-rkaklia demade rkenia la roma nhio'la geni.
